14 / MINERAL BUYING

Begin a mineral purchase with clear information.

Mineral buying begins with knowing what material is on offer, the seller’s right to sell, how quantity and composition are documented and what commercial terms require agreement. ASL’s enquiry pathway helps organise the initial discussion without implying a standing purchase offer.

THE SERVICE IN CONTEXT

A defined scope leads to a better decision.

Explore sourcing enquiries, material descriptions, due diligence and purchase considerations.

The suitable approach depends on the material, the intended outcome and the details agreed by the parties.

Make a service enquiry ↗
A CLOSER LOOK

What deserves attention.

Different specimen forms and questions call for different considerations. The following themes help frame the discussion.

01

Describe what is being offered

Material type, grade or assay evidence, volume, physical form and location help establish whether a buying discussion can be meaningful. Different minerals have different handling and market requirements.

02

Verify the counterparty and material

Responsible purchasing discussions involve seller identification, provenance and ownership documentation, applicable permits, export status where relevant and a defensible understanding of the material offered.

03

Agree commercial terms separately

Pricing basis, sampling rights, delivery point, settlement, acceptance criteria and liability need written agreement between the actual parties. Displaying this service is not a commitment to purchase material at any price.

BEFORE YOU BEGIN

What to prepare.

A few useful details can make your first enquiry much more focused.

  • Mineral type and physical form
  • Available quantity and location
  • Grade/assay results and sample information
  • Seller identity, ownership and licence documents
  • Expected pricing basis and delivery terms
Explore preparation guides ↗
COMMON QUESTIONS

A little more clarity.

Can I sell minerals instantly through the site?+
No. The website starts a buying enquiry; it is not a live marketplace or binding offer.
Does ASL buy every mineral listed?+
Material interest, eligibility and commercial terms must be reviewed for each proposed transaction.
